Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
Fellow Methusalehs:

This recently came up in a game. Leonardo the Mortician "may move 1
blood from the blood bank to any ready vampire as a +1 stealth
action". If the ready vampire is controlled by the same Methusaleh as
Leonardo, who can block this action? If the ready vampire is
controlled by someone across the table, who can block??

I would presume that this follows the same rules as rescuing a vampire
from torpor, and so the answers would be:

** controlled by the same Methusaleh -- can only be blocked by that
Methusaleh's prey and predator

** controlled by someone across the table -- can only be blocked by
that Methusaleh across the table (i.e. controller of the vampire), and
why would he or she want to do that??

Can someone confirm or deny this?

TIA,
Madman

Same Meth: Predator/Prey.
Across the table: Target.

> I would presume that this follows the same rules as rescuing a vampire
> from torpor, and so the answers would be:
>
> ** controlled by the same Methusaleh -- can only be blocked by that
> Methusaleh's prey and predator
>
> ** controlled by someone across the table -- can only be blocked by
> that Methusaleh across the table (i.e. controller of the vampire), and
> why would he or she want to do that??
>
> Can someone confirm or deny this?

Confirmed explicitly in 6.2.2.1

(Why block the (D) version? - Maybe you've got Triole's Revenge on
you or are planning on using Jake Washington on your untap)
